disclaimer: Zagayowar Al'ada tana nan don fahimtar motsa jiki da hutu kawai. Ba shawarar likita ba ce, ba kayan gano cuta ba ce, kuma bai kamata a taɓa amfani da ita don hana ɗaukar ciki ko shirin haihuwa ba. Hasashe ƙiyasi ne daga kwanakin da kika shigar.
settings.summaryShared: Ana bibiya · an raba da kocinki
settings.trackingDesc: Shigar da ranar farko ta al'adarki; Shape kuma zai karanta matakinki da ɗabi'un da ke tafiya da shi. Naki kaɗai ne sai kin raba shi.
settings.shareDesc: Kociyoyin da kika haɗa za su ga matakinki da kwanakin farawa na baya-bayan nan — don motsa jiki da abinci su bi makonki. Kina iya kashe shi kowane lokaci.
settings.shareOffDesc: Zai samu idan bibiyar zagayowar al'ada tana kunne.
settings.stopDesc: Yana share kowace ranar da kika shigar kuma yana dakatar da rabawa. Ba za a iya mayar da wannan ba.
optIn.body: Shigar da ranar farko ta al'adarki, Shape kuma zai karanta yadda take zagayowa — inda kike a zagayenki, da abin da yakan bayyana gare ki a can cikin barci, ƙarfi da motsa jiki.
optIn.privacy: Naki ne kuma naki zai kasance. Ba a raba komai da koci sai kin kunna rabawa, kuma dakatarwa tana share kowace ranar da kika shigar.
optIn.done: An kunna bibiyar zagayowar al'ada — shigar da al'adarki ta ƙarshe don farawa.
share.consent: Na yarda in raba matakin zagayowar al'adata da kwanakin farawa na baya-bayan nan da kociyoyin da na haɗa. Ina iya kashe wannan kowane lokaci.
optOut.title: A dakatar da bibiya a kuma share?
optOut.message: Wannan yana share kowace ranar da kika shigar kuma yana kashe bibiyar zagayowar al'ada. Idan kina rabawa da koci, wannan ma zai tsaya. Ba za a iya mayar da wannan ba.
optOut.done: An dakatar da bibiyar zagayowar al'ada — an share kwanakinki.
err.unavailable: Saitin zagayowar al'ada bai samu ba tukuna. Ki sake gwadawa nan ba da jimawa ba.
err.generic: Wannan bai ajiye ba. Ki sake gwadawa.
paused: Zagayen yana daɗewa — an dakatar da hasashe.
late: Sabon zagaye yana farawa lokacin da kika shigar da shi.
cal.setupTitle: Shigar da ranar farko ta al'adarki ta ƙarshe don farawa.
cal.setupBody: Danna kowace ranar da ta wuce a kalanda. Bayan zagaye biyu ko uku, Shape zai fara karanta ɗabi'arki.
cal.loggedMeta: {n, plural, one {Kwana # da aka shigar} other {Kwanaki # da aka shigar}}
cal.noFuture: Ba za a iya shigar da ranar gaba ba.
cal.unlogMessage: Wannan yana cire farkon al'adar da kika shigar a wannan ranar.
cal.hint: Danna rana don shigar da ranar farko ta al'ada. Sake dannawa don cire ta.
card.setup: Shigar da farkon al'ada don farawa.
